profile.headline: Senior Engineer, Data & Operations Lead
profile.summary:
I'm a critical thinker. I believe that good software is made for human beings, by human beings. I have a practical, direct style rooted in trust, communication, and accountability.

I'm also a generalist, flexibly offering support in different ways as needed. At MEDS.com, I support the telemedicine platform: connecting the engineering and medical teams;  finding and analyzing data to illuminate business processes; scoping features and coordinating development. I also spend a lot of time designing, building, and documenting data flows, and making information meaningful using dashboards built with Google BigQuery and Looker / Looker Studio

In my free time I do environmental advocacy as the board president of Neighbors For Environmental Justice and build tools for working with public data at publicdatatools.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer: Data and Operations Lead
positions.description: Leading a small team in the engineering department focused on data and operations. Working towards robust infrastructure, realistic testing, observable systems, and measurable impacts; helping to develop both software and engineers
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Critical Thinking and +3 skills

positions.title: Product Data Manager
positions.description: Product management + building data dashboards with BigQuery / Data Studio

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Managing and leading a small team in the support and development of multi-platform ecommerce applications at Blitsy

• Designed and built ETL product data pipeline with Python microservices, integrated with a 3rd party API
• Helped spec and build a custom AWS Lambda development framework for Python lambdas
• Upgraded core microservices from Python 2.7 to 3.7
• Supported and developed custom Warehouse Management System (PHP, jQuery, HTML, CSS) with new classes and features including multi-facility fulfillment
• Developed algorithms for efficiently slotting inventory & predicting sales
• Helped to spec and stand up two B2C warehouses
• Automated generation of complex financial reports
• Did data analysis with Jupyter notebooks & Pandas
• Built serverless APIs to expose warehouse data

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building microservices in AWS with MYSQL and Python. Automation, data engineering and analysis, and more.

positions.title: Director of Online Sales and Social Media
positions.description:
STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS
Creating and maintaining strategic partnerships with festivals, magazines, non-profits and museums, including WYCC PBS Chicago, Columbia College, 57th Street Art Fair, American Blues Scene, Mahindra Blues Festival, PCaBlue, OnePatient Global Health Initiative, the National Blues Museum, and more. 

ONLINE CONTENT
Creating compelling content and maintaining the channels and accounts through which it is distributed. That includes doing artist interviews, directing multi-camera live broadcasts, writing and editing articles, taking photos, scheduling and supervising film shoots, and managing social media presence: Facebook, Twitter, Youtube, Instagram, Pinterest, Google Business, etc.

MEDIA ARCHIVING
Creating and maintaining a multimedia archive of Buddy Guy, Legends, and blues history. Includes everything from archival photos, bootleg video culled from various sources, automated recordings, posters, performance schedules, prototypes and more.

EVENT PRODUCTION
Being involved in the planning and execution of special events, ranging from sold out shows with hundreds of fans and celebrity guests to afternoon symposia on the issues facing the blues community.

ONLINE SALES
Listing and shipping autographed memorabilia, managing inventory, monitoring ticket sales.

positions.title: Technologist
positions.description:
- Maintaining a mix of cloud-based and on-site infrastructure (Amazon Web Services: EC2, Route 52, Cloudfront, RDS)
- Support and troubleshoot live video streaming from concert halls, bars and theaters
- Configuring media servers, etc
